rows.role_title: King (Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques)
rows.text: Release dated February 13, 1996 on the Royal Embassy's February 1996 page: 'Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Fahd Bin Abdul Aziz yesterday evening chaired the regular weekly meeting of the Council of Ministers'.
rows.locator: February 1996 page; item 'COUNCIL OF MINISTERS MEETING', February 13, 1996, first sentence

rows.text: Item dated 'February 22' on the Royal Embassy's February 1996 page: King Fahd 'yesterday sent a message to Crown Prince Abdullah, Deputy Prime Minister and Commander of the National Guard', thanking him for his efforts 'while entrusted with running the affairs of state' and writing 'at the end of the validity of royal decree A-112 dated 11/30/95'; the Crown Prince's reply acknowledges 'your royal decree A-199 dated 02/21/96 with the message that your period of rest is ended'.
rows.locator: February 1996 page; item 'KING FAHD EXPRESSES APPRECIATION TO CROWN PRINCE ABDULLAH', February 22, paragraphs 1-3
